rationale: I read the complete P1–P6 proposal and score policy and independently verified the file hash. P1 ties character behavior to truthful authorship while keeping content understandable without motion. P2 allows expressive timing exploration without prescribing extra activity or anatomy. P3 treats material and edge changes as reversible comparisons at actual use sizes. P4 directly addresses my reading-key concern and preserves native selection, focus, motion preferences and mobile evidence boundaries. P5 requires renderer proof while distinguishing reliable implementation from creative approval. P6 separates owner fit, expert judgment and human response, permits lower or withheld scores and protects silence. The sequence can improve personality and comfort without making speculative audience claims or turning research into a gate on unrelated authorized work. Adoption requires an observed, named benefit; keeping the baseline remains valid.
